project_title: AI-Driven Disaster Management and Rescue System (Computer Networks PBL)
context_type: Data-dense command-center style dashboard & crisis monitoring system
theme: Dark Tactical Command (Obsidian / Slate Navy base with High-Contrast Tactical Accents)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide font-heading

layout_and_grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Tactical Command Grid (Mode B)
layout_and_grids.containers: bg-[#121824]/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-lg p-5 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative

motion_and_interactions.animations: framer-motion staggered entrance for list items and live feed alerts
motion_and_interactions.pulse_effects: animate-pulse for active critical alerts and live IoT sensor status

network_and_security_pbl_features.pbl_badges: Include explicit indicators for Computer Networks & Cybersecurity concepts (e.g., MQTT/WebSocket Feed Latency, End-to-End Encryption RSA-2048, Mesh Node Topology, DDoS Mitigation Status, Edge-Cloud Synchronization)
network_and_security_pbl_features.role_based_access: Support Admin (Command Control), Rescue Team (Tactical Dispatch), Citizen (Victim SOS Portal) mode switching

image_urls.description: Mobile command center seats with monitors displaying digital maps
Aerial view of rescue response vehicles and tactical staging area
Firefighters during emergency building rescue operation
Satellite dish platform representing space-ground telemetry and network node

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_policy: WCAG AA high-contrast readable dark theme with clear status icons and high contrast labels
accessibility_and_testing.test_id_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, maps, inputs, tabs, modal actions, and status indicators MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sos-report-button', data-testid='incident-filter-dropdown', data-testid='iot-sensor-temp-card')

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JS/JSX files only (not TSX) as per codebase environment.
Ensure header navigation is fixed with backdrop blur (bg-[#0A0D14]/80) and never fully transparent.
Ensure all buttons and inputs use custom styled Tailwind/Shadcn primitives with distinct hover and focus states.
Integrate interactive disaster map visualization (using custom SVG or Map rendering with interactive markers).
Build real-time simulated WebSocket / IoT event logs with pause/resume simulation feature.
Provide clear role tabs (Admin Command / Rescue Operator / Citizen SOS) with tailored viewports.
Include network metrics header banner (Ping, Packet Loss, Bandwidth, Encrypted Mesh Status) to emphasize the Computer Networks PBL theme.
